title: Fan-in bound for the tabulated circuit
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite set of instruction kinds, let $m,w,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $F$ assign to each kind a function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For every finite program of instructions with kinds in $\kappa$, and every pair of natural numbers $o,j$, the tabulated circuit is well formed: each gate has distinct arguments, every NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ maps each instruction kind and Boolean list to a Boolean list
the program is a list of instructions with kinds in $\kappa$
